description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses from MTD partition data specific to the Phicomm K2T device, including functions to load configuration data and retrieve MAC addresses.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads and parses the JSON configuration data from the MTD partition named 'config'.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves a specified MAC address value from the loaded device configuration JSON data.
